basis: HARDENING_ROUND_001 evidence; same 4 frozen designator coordinates as Phase-2A pr_relation.json
changes_vs_r0: interface-scoped coincidence lemma added (bag-identity == Match-vector on admitted histories)
error-token semantics added (missing+MustBePresent-true => Indeterminate token; empty unreachable here)
5-to-4 dedup rationale added (action bag held once, evaluated twice)
issuer note added (null throughout; pooling immaterial here)
dedup_rationale: 5 designator occurrences project to 4 coordinates: the action-id coordinate carries two literals (read/write, policy.xml:34-43); the bag is held once and evaluated twice by the two Matches.
error_tokens: Missing with MustBePresent=true evaluates to Indeterminate (N1 7.3.5), not an empty bag; P_R compares Indeterminate tokens as distinct from any value bag. Empty-bag state is unreachable in this fixture (all designators MustBePresent=true and every admitted history supplies or misses discretely).
granularity_note: Bag-identity is strictly finer than Match-outcome equivalence in general (duplicates, extra non-matching values, Issuer pooling). On the admitted interface (singleton bags, Issuer null, exact datatypes) the two relations coincide extensionally; the coincidence is proven by the match table, not assumed.
issuer_note: All designators omit Issuer and all admitted bags carry Issuer null; per Sec. 7.3.4 (frozen lines 8394-8401) matching ignores context Issuer here, so pooling is immaterial.
rule: Histories h1, h2 are P_R-equivalent iff, for every frozen designator coordinate, the Match-vector entries coincide: each coordinate contributes TRUE (bag matches literal), FALSE (bag present, no match), or INDETERMINATE (bag missing with MustBePresent=true). On the admitted interface this coincides exactly with sorted-typed-multiset bag equality.
